convert.title: Switch {{control}} to gestures?
convert.click: {{control}} acts as soon as it is pressed. A Work Session controller needs gestures, so its single click becomes a gesture. With no double click or long press it still fires on the press.
convert.doubleClick: {{control}} acts as soon as it is pressed. To add a {{gesture}}, its single click becomes a gesture: it then fires after the double-click window ({{ms}} ms) has passed without a second press, so it reacts a little later than now.
convert.longPress: {{control}} acts as soon as it is pressed. To add a {{gesture}}, its single click becomes a gesture: it then fires when the key is released before the long-press time ({{ms}} ms), so it reacts a little later than now.
convert.release: Its release binding (“{{target}}”) is removed: a key with gestures cannot also react to its release.
convert.untilSaved: Nothing changes on the device until you save the layout.
